title: Bečki aerodrom dobio prijetnje za četiri leta
Vienna airport receives threats against four flights
body: Aerodrom u Beču je u srijedu u 8:50 dobio e-poruku s prijetnjom za četiri leta.
The airport in Vienna received an email at 8:50 with a threat against four flights.
Policija je rekla da je prijetnja apstraktna, a detalje nije objavila.
The police said the threat was abstract and did not release any details.
Avion kompanije Wizz Air, koji je letio iz Milana za Varšavu, sletio je u Beč.
A Wizz Air plane, which was flying from Milan to Warsaw, landed in Vienna.
Policajci su pretražili avion, ali nisu našli ništa sumnjivo, pa je nastavio put.
Officers searched the plane but found nothing suspicious, so it continued its journey.
Glasnogovornik policije Stefan Loidl rekao je da je prijetnja poslana e-poštom u Poljskoj.
Police spokesperson Stefan Loidl said the threat was sent by email in Poland.
Prijetnja je stigla i za let kompanije Finnair iz Helsinkija za Beč, koji je sletio prema planu.
A threat also came for a Finnair flight from Helsinki to Vienna, which landed as planned.
Aerodrom je naveo da redovan saobraćaj nije bio poremećen.
The airport said that regular traffic was not disrupted.
Slične prijetnje bile su i u drugim evropskim zemljama.
Similar threats were also made in other European countries.
Italijanski borbeni avioni pratili su Finnairov let iz Helsinkija do Rima.
Italian fighter jets escorted a Finnair flight from Helsinki to Rome.
U Bugarskoj su tri aviona sletjela ranije nego što je bilo planirano zbog prijetnji.
In Bulgaria three planes landed earlier than planned because of threats.
Avion koji je letio iz Dublina za Rim sletio je na francusku vojnu bazu Évreux.
A plane flying from Dublin to Rome landed at the French military base Évreux.

title: Toplane Sarajevo nude plaćanje duga na rate
Toplane Sarajevo offer payment of debt in instalments
body: Sarajevska kompanija Toplane objavila je nove mogućnosti za korisnike koji imaju dugove.
The Sarajevo company Toplane announced new options for customers who have debts.
Ko ne može odjednom platiti cijeli dug, može potpisati ugovor o plaćanju na rate.
Whoever cannot pay the whole debt at once can sign a contract to pay in instalments.
Broj mjesečnih rata zavisi od visine duga i od načina na koji će kompanija osigurati naplatu.
The number of monthly instalments depends on the size of the debt and on how the company will secure payment.
Neki korisnici su već potpisali dogovor o ratama, ali ga nisu mogli ispuniti iz objektivnih razloga.
Some customers have already signed an instalment agreement but could not keep it for objective reasons.
Oni mogu ponovo razgovarati s kompanijom i dogovoriti nove uslove plaćanja.
They can talk to the company again and agree on new payment terms.
Osim toga, Toplane će otpisati zakonske zatezne kamate ako korisnik plati cijeli glavni dug i sudske troškove.
In addition, Toplane will write off the statutory default interest if the customer pays the whole principal debt and the court costs.
Kompanija naglašava da se misli na ukupne sudske troškove, a ne na troškove jednog slučaja.
The company stresses that this means the total court costs, not the costs of a single case.
Glavni dug se može platiti odjednom ili na rate.
The principal debt can be paid at once or in instalments.
Nakon toga se potpisuje sporazum o otpisu kamata, a Toplane povlače slučaj iz Općinskog suda.
After that an agreement on writing off the interest is signed, and Toplane withdraws the case from the Municipal Court.
Sve informacije korisnici mogu dobiti u centrima za korisnike kompanije.
Customers can get all the information in the company's customer centres.

title: Rekord u Brazilu: na jednoj utakmici isključeno 51 osoba
Record in Brazil: 51 people sent off in one match
body: Na omladinskoj utakmici u Brazilu postavljen je novi Guinnessov svjetski rekord po broju isključenja.
A new Guinness world record for the number of sendings-off was set at a youth match in Brazil.
Sudija je isključio 43 igrača i 8 članova stručnih štabova, ukupno 51 osobu.
The referee sent off 43 players and 8 members of coaching staffs, 51 people in total.
Ako se računaju i dva člana uprave kluba Uberlândia, broj crvenih kartona je 53.
If two board members of the club Uberlândia are also counted, the number of red cards is 53.
Igralo se prvo polufinale državnog prvenstva do 20 godina u državi Minas Gerais između Uberlândije i Mamorea.
It was the first semifinal of the under-20 state championship in the state of Minas Gerais between Uberlândia and Mamoré.
Početkom drugog poluvremena isključen je jedan igrač Uberlândije, pa su na teren utrčali neki predstavnici tog kluba.
At the start of the second half one Uberlândia player was sent off, and then some representatives of that club ran onto the pitch.
Utakmica je zbog toga bila prekinuta 40 minuta.
Because of this the match was stopped for 40 minutes.
Nakon nastavka Mamoré je u devetom minutu nadoknade postigao gol za 3:1.
After the restart Mamoré scored in the ninth minute of stoppage time to make it 3-1.
Brazilski mediji pišu da je igrač Mamorea provocirao protivnike dok je slavio, a nakon toga je počela masovna tuča.
Brazilian media write that a Mamoré player provoked his opponents while celebrating, and after that a mass brawl began.
Sudija Fernando Patrick Drosghic Modesto napisao je da se tuča dogodila u 54. minuti drugog poluvremena.
Referee Fernando Patrick Drosghic Modesto wrote that the brawl happened in the 54th minute of the second half.
Zbog haosa i nesigurnosti nije mogao pokazati sve kartone i odlučio je završiti utakmicu.
Because of the chaos and lack of safety he could not show all the cards and decided to end the match.
Policiji je prijavio prijetnje protiv sebe, a rekao je i da su igrači Mamorea nakon utakmice razbili svlačionicu.
He reported threats against himself to the police, and he also said that Mamoré players smashed the dressing room after the match.
Prethodni rekord bio je 36 crvenih kartona, na utakmici u Argentini 2011. godine.
The previous record was 36 red cards, at a match in Argentina in 2011.

title: Bluetooth će biti znatno brži: usvojen novi standard
Bluetooth will be much faster: a new standard has been adopted
body: Organizacija Bluetooth SIG, koja razvija standard za Bluetooth, usvojila je novi način rada pod imenom HDT.
The organisation Bluetooth SIG, which develops the Bluetooth standard, has adopted a new mode called HDT.
Najveća brzina za uređaje s Bluetooth LE povećava se sa 2 na 7,5 megabita u sekundi.
The top speed for devices with Bluetooth LE rises from 2 to 7.5 megabits per second.
To je skoro četiri puta više nego do sada.
That is almost four times more than until now.
Novi način rada koristi složenije metode prenosa, pa isti signal nosi više podataka.
The new mode uses more complex transmission methods, so the same signal carries more data.
Proizvođači ga ne moraju ugraditi, a uređaji mogu smanjiti brzinu kada je signal slabiji.
Manufacturers do not have to include it, and devices can lower the speed when the signal is weaker.
Organizacija tvrdi da veća brzina ne troši više baterije, jer se podaci prenesu brže.
The organisation says that higher speed does not use more battery, because the data is transferred faster.
U prvim demonstracijama datoteka od nekoliko megabajta prenesena je za oko 4 sekunde, a sada je potrebno oko 16.
In the first demonstrations a file of several megabytes was transferred in about 4 seconds, while now it takes about 16.
Sigurnosni kodi za provjeru poruka također će biti duži.
The security codes for checking messages will also be longer.
Prvi uređaji s novom tehnologijom očekuju se početkom 2027. godine.
The first devices with the new technology are expected in early 2027.
Pametni satovi, pametne naočale i kućni uređaji mogli bi brže slati podatke telefonu.
Smartwatches, smart glasses and home devices could send data to the phone faster.
Za punu brzinu oba uređaja moraju podržavati HDT, ali će stariji telefoni i dalje raditi.
For full speed both devices must support HDT, but older phones will still work.

title: Divovski psi žive kraće: u prosjeku samo 8,9 godina
Giant dogs live shorter lives: only 8.9 years on average
body: Velika britanska studija pokazala je da divovske pasmine žive u prosjeku 8,9 godina.
A large British study showed that giant breeds live 8.9 years on average.
To je otprilike tri godine manje nego kod svih pasa zajedno.
That is roughly three years less than for all dogs together.
Studiju je vodio profesor Dan O'Neill s Kraljevskog veterinarskog fakulteta u Londonu.
The study was led by Professor Dan O'Neill from the Royal Veterinary College in London.
Istraživači su pregledali anonimne veterinarske zapise o 2,25 miliona pasa koji su liječeni 2019. godine.
The researchers looked at anonymous veterinary records of 2.25 million dogs that were treated in 2019.
Među njima je bilo 28.345 pasa iz 29 divovskih pasmina, a podatke za više od 4.300 detaljno su analizirali.
Among them were 28,345 dogs from 29 giant breeds, and they analysed the data for more than 4,300 in detail.
Tibetanski mastif živi najkraće, samo 4,8 godina, a ženke žive oko 0,8 godina duže od mužjaka.
The Tibetan mastiff lives the shortest, only 4.8 years, and females live about 0.8 years longer than males.
Najčešći uzrok smrti je rak.
The most common cause of death is cancer.
Čak 73,8 posto divovskih pasa imalo je bar jedan zdravstveni problem tokom godine.
As many as 73.8 percent of giant dogs had at least one health problem during the year.
Istraživači misle da brži rast kod ovih pasa vodi do bržeg starenja.
The researchers think that faster growth in these dogs leads to faster ageing.
Profesor O'Neill kaže da su divovski psi divni ljubimci, ali da njihova veličina ima visoku cijenu.
Professor O'Neill says giant dogs are wonderful pets, but that their size comes at a high price.
Prema njegovim riječima, kratak život ovih pasa trebao bi pokrenuti širu raspravu o uzgoju.
According to him, the short life of these dogs should start a wider debate about breeding.
On vjeruje da bi umjerena veličina mogla produžiti život tih pasmina.
He believes that a moderate size could extend the life of these breeds.

title: Kongres interventnih radiologa u Sarajevu: 49 predavača iz 14 zemalja
Congress of interventional radiologists in Sarajevo: 49 lecturers from 14 countries
body: U Sarajevu će od 6. do 8. novembra biti održan drugi kongres interventnih radiologa u BiH.
The second congress of interventional radiologists in BiH will be held in Sarajevo from 6 to 8 November.
Organizator je Udruženje interventnih radiologa i minimalno invazivnih terapeuta u BiH.
The organiser is the Association of Interventional Radiologists and Minimally Invasive Therapists in BiH.
Kongres će biti u hotelu Mövenpick, a očekuje se više od 200 učesnika iz različitih oblasti medicine.
The congress will be at the Mövenpick hotel, and more than 200 participants from different fields of medicine are expected.
Predavat će 49 stručnjaka iz 14 zemalja.
49 experts from 14 countries will give lectures.
Teme su nove metode u liječenju krvnih žila, ali i drugih organa, te zahvati na mozgu.
The topics are new methods in treating blood vessels, but also other organs, and procedures on the brain.
Interventna radiologija je grana medicine u kojoj ljekari liječe pacijente kroz male otvore na tijelu, pa su operacije često manje opasne.
Interventional radiology is a branch of medicine in which doctors treat patients through small openings in the body, so operations are often less risky.
Učesnici će dobiti i 13,5 bodova za stručno usavršavanje koje priznaje Evropsko vijeće za radiologiju.
Participants will also receive 13.5 credits for professional training recognised by the European Board of Radiology.
Među organizatorima i predavačima su ljekari s Klinike za radiologiju Kliničkog centra Univerziteta u Sarajevu.
Among the organisers and lecturers are doctors from the Clinic for Radiology of the Clinical Centre of the University of Sarajevo.
Predsjednik organizacionog odbora je docent doktor Deniz Bulja, šef odjela za interventnu radiologiju na toj klinici.
The president of the organising committee is Assistant Professor Dr Deniz Bulja, head of the interventional radiology department at that clinic.
Organizatori ističu da je cilj kongresa da se predstave savremene metode liječenja.
The organisers stress that the goal of the congress is to present modern methods of treatment.

title: Studentska lista predlaže četverodnevnu radnu sedmicu
The Student List proposes a four-day work week
body: Studentska lista u Srbiji predstavila je prijedlog novih pravila za radnike.
The Student List in Serbia has presented a proposal for new rules for workers.
Najviše pažnje privlači ideja o četverodnevnoj radnoj sedmici od 32 sata bez smanjenja plate.
The idea of a four-day work week of 32 hours without a pay cut attracts the most attention.
Ona ne bi bila obavezna, nego bi je poslodavci mogli izabrati sami.
It would not be mandatory; employers could choose it themselves.
Radnici bi nakon 12 mjeseci rada dobili ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme.
After 12 months of work, workers would get a permanent contract.
Ugovori na određeno vrijeme trajali bi najviše 12 mjeseci, a s istim radnikom bi se mogla potpisati najviše četiri.
Fixed-term contracts would last at most 12 months, and at most four could be signed with the same worker.
Dodaci na platu bili bi veći: 150 posto za rad praznikom, 110 posto za rad nedjeljom i po 50 posto za noćni rad i prekovremene sate.
Supplements to pay would be higher: 150 percent for work on holidays, 110 percent for work on Sundays and 50 percent each for night work and overtime.
Poslodavci bi morali objaviti raspon plate u oglasima za posao.
Employers would have to publish the salary range in job ads.
Prijedlog uključuje i tri mjeseca očinskog odsustva te penzije koje bi se usklađivale dvaput godišnje.
The proposal also includes three months of paternity leave and pensions that would be adjusted twice a year.
Autori kažu da sadašnji zakon ne štiti dovoljno radnike koji nemaju standardan posao.
The authors say that the current law does not protect workers without a standard job well enough.
Za sve ove promjene bilo bi potrebno promijeniti zakon.
All these changes would require amending the law.

title: Wembanyama sa 52 poena i 24 skoka srušio Dallas
Wembanyama beat Dallas with 52 points and 24 rebounds
body: Košarkaš Victor Wembanyama odigrao je utakmicu kakvu NBA liga do sada nije vidjela.
Basketball player Victor Wembanyama played a game the NBA has not seen until now.
San Antonio je pobijedio Dallas 112:111, a Francuz je postigao 52 poena.
San Antonio beat Dallas 112:111, and the Frenchman scored 52 points.
Uz to je uhvatio 24 skoka i blokirao osam šuteva za 34 minute igre.
In addition, he grabbed 24 rebounds and blocked eight shots in 34 minutes of play.
Pogodio je 16 od 28 šuteva iz igre i 19 od 23 slobodnih bacanja.
He made 16 of 28 shots from the field and 19 of 23 free throws.
Prema izvještaju, nijedan igrač u historiji lige nije imao takav učinak.
According to the report, no player in the league's history has had such a performance.
Najbliže tome je bio Bob McAdoo 1974. godine.
Bob McAdoo came closest to it in 1974.
Već na poluvremenu imao je 29 poena, 15 skokova i pet blokada.
Already at halftime he had 29 points, 15 rebounds and five blocks.
San Antonio je u jednom trenutku vodio sa 19 poena razlike, ali se Dallas vratio.
San Antonio led by 19 points at one point, but Dallas came back.
Naji Marshall je pogodio tricu minutu i 41 sekundu prije kraja i izjednačio na 111.
Naji Marshall hit a three-pointer one minute and 41 seconds before the end and tied it at 111.
Wembanyama je zatim pogodio jedno slobodno bacanje, a Kyrie Irving je promašio posljednji šut.
Wembanyama then made one free throw, and Kyrie Irving missed the last shot.
San Antonio ima šest pobjeda zaredom, dok je Dallas izgubio drugi put uzastopno.
San Antonio has six wins in a row, while Dallas has lost for the second time in a row.

title: Zdravstveni radnici u Sarajevu traže veće plate za sve
Health workers in Sarajevo demand higher pay for everyone
body: Zdravstveni radnici danas u 10 sati protestuju ispred Vlade Kantona Sarajevo.
Health workers are protesting today at 10 o'clock in front of the Sarajevo Canton Government.
Protest organizuje Glavni odbor Sindikata radnika zaposlenih u zdravstvu.
The protest is organized by the Main Board of the Union of Health Sector Workers.
Nezadovoljni su zato što su nedavna povećanja plata dobili samo doktori.
They are unhappy because only doctors received the recent pay increases.
Sindikat traži hitne izmjene kolektivnog ugovora.
The union demands urgent changes to the collective agreement.
Želi i da se plate povećaju svim zaposlenim u zdravstvu, a ne samo ljekarima.
It also wants salaries to be raised for all health sector employees, not only physicians.
Osim toga, traži saglasnost za početak pregovora o novom kolektivnom ugovoru jer sadašnji ističe sljedeće godine.
In addition, it asks for approval to start negotiations on a new collective agreement because the current one expires next year.
Zahtjevi su upućeni Ministarstvu zdravstva i Vladi Kantona Sarajevo.
The demands have been sent to the Ministry of Health and the Sarajevo Canton Government.
Predsjednik sindikata Senad Sadiković rekao je da žele da radnici u zdravstvu budu ravnopravni.
Union president Senad Sadiković said they want health workers to be treated equally.
Nije poznato koliko ljudi će doći na protest.
It is not known how many people will come to the protest.

title: Nafta pojeftinila skoro devet posto nakon izbora u SAD-u
Oil became almost nine percent cheaper after the US elections
body: Nakon američkih izbora cijene nafte naglo su pale, a dionice su porasle.
After the American elections oil prices dropped sharply, and shares rose.
Republikanci su izgubili kontrolu nad Washingtonom, pa je Wall Street u srijedu snažno porastao.
The Republicans lost control of Washington, so Wall Street rose strongly on Wednesday.
Indeks S&P 500 porastao je 1,6 posto, a Dow Jones više od 1.500 bodova.
The S&P 500 index rose 1.6 percent, and the Dow Jones more than 1,500 points.
Nafta Brent pojeftinila je 8,7 posto i koštala 94,62 dolara za barel, što je blizu najniže cijene u dva mjeseca.
Brent oil became 8.7 percent cheaper and cost 94.62 dollars per barrel, which is close to the lowest price in two months.
Analitičari kažu da bi Kongres pod kontrolom demokrata mogao natjerati Trumpa da završi rat s Iranom.
Analysts say that a Congress controlled by Democrats could push Trump to end the war with Iran.
Dionice kompanije Trump Media pale su 24,5 posto, a Tesla i SpaceX izgubili su po oko 3 do 4 posto.
Shares of Trump Media fell 24.5 percent, and Tesla and SpaceX lost about 3 to 4 percent each.
Pale su i dionice proizvođača oružja, dok su kompanije za obnovljivu energiju zabilježile rast.
Shares of weapons makers also fell, while renewable energy companies recorded growth.
Azijske berze u četvrtak nisu reagovale isto: južnokorejski Kospi pao je oko 3,5 posto, a Hang Seng u Hong Kongu porastao je 2,8 posto.
Asian stock markets did not react the same on Thursday: South Korea's Kospi fell about 3.5 percent, and the Hang Seng in Hong Kong rose 2.8 percent.
Dolar je oslabio, a euro je vrijedio 1,1256 dolara.
The dollar weakened, and the euro was worth 1.1256 dollars.
Članak ističe da izbori na dugi rok možda malo utiču na tržište, jer ga više pokreću zarade kompanija i kamatne stope.
The article points out that in the long run elections may have little effect on the market, because company profits and interest rates drive it more.

title: Metsola upozorila europarlamentarce na umjetnu inteligenciju
Metsola warned MEPs about artificial intelligence
body: Predsjednica Evropskog parlamenta Roberta Metsola upozorila je poslanike da se ne oslanjaju previše na umjetnu inteligenciju.
European Parliament President Roberta Metsola warned members not to rely too much on artificial intelligence.
Parlament trenutno priprema nove smjernice o tome kako se ona smije koristiti.
The Parliament is currently preparing new guidelines on how it may be used.
Izvještaj je objavila agencija SRNA.
The report was published by the SRNA agency.
Metsola je rekla da umjetna inteligencija ne može zamijeniti ljudsku procjenu ni političku radnu.
Metsola said that artificial intelligence cannot replace human judgment or political work.
Prema njenim riječima, pisanje amandmana uz pomoć vještačke inteligencije ne može zamijeniti konstruktivnu raspravu s kolegom.
According to her, writing amendments with the help of AI cannot replace a constructive discussion with a colleague.
Isto vrijedi za pravna istraživanja, jer teška odluka traži kritičko razmišljanje.
The same goes for legal research, because a difficult decision requires critical thinking.
Naglasila je da odgovornost uvijek ostaje na izabranim predstavnicima.
She stressed that responsibility always stays with the elected representatives.
Generalni sekretar Parlamenta rekao je da se pravi vlastiti alat za osjetljive poslove.
The Parliament's secretary general said that its own tool is being built for sensitive work.
Radit će na internoj infrastrukturi, pa podaci neće izlaziti iz institucije.
It will run on internal infrastructure, so data will not leave the institution.
Za manje osjetljive zadatke i dalje se mogu koristiti komercijalni modeli.
Commercial models can still be used for less sensitive tasks.
Zvaničnici se brinu jer neki amandmani pisani uz pomoć AI navode zakone koji ne postoje.
Officials are worried because some amendments written with the help of AI cite laws that do not exist.

title: Oko 150 volontera sadit će 3.000 sadnica kod Zavidovića
About 150 volunteers will plant 3,000 seedlings near Zavidovići
body: Kod Zavidovića će u subotu, 7. novembra, biti zasađeno 3.000 sadnica.
Near Zavidovići, 3,000 seedlings will be planted on Saturday, 7 November.
To je 12. akcija pošumljavanja u okviru kampanje Boranka.
It is the 12th reforestation action within the Boranka campaign.
Očekuje se oko 150 volontera.
About 150 volunteers are expected.
Akciju organizuje Savez izviđača Federacije BiH, a partner je Šumarija Zavidovići.
The action is organized by the Scout Association of the Federation of BiH, and the partner is the Zavidovići forestry office.
Domaćin je izviđački odred "Klek" iz Zavidovića.
The host is the scout troop "Klek" from Zavidovići.
Sadnice će se saditi na Maloj Maoči, gdje se spajaju granice Zavidovića i Općine Olovo.
The seedlings will be planted at Mala Maoča, where the borders of Zavidovići and the Municipality of Olovo meet.
To područje je ranije stradalo u šumskim požarima.
That area was previously damaged in forest fires.
Volonteri će doći iz Sarajeva, Mostara, Doboj Istoka i Zenice.
Volunteers will come from Sarajevo, Mostar, Doboj Istok and Zenica.
Učestvovat će i Crveni križ, dvije srednje škole iz Zavidovića i druge organizacije.
The Red Cross, two secondary schools from Zavidovići and other organizations will also take part.
Organizatori su rekli da žele pomoći da se opožarena područja ponovo zazelene.
The organizers said they want to help burned areas become green again.
Zahvalili su i gradonačelnici Zavidovića na podršci.
They also thanked the mayor of Zavidovići for her support.

title: Navijači BiH u Kopru pjevali prije utakmice sa Slovenijom
BiH fans sang in Koper before the match with Slovenia
body: Rukometaši BiH večeras igraju protiv Slovenije u Kopru.
The BiH handball players are playing against Slovenia in Koper tonight.
To je prvo kolo kvalifikacija za Evropsko prvenstvo 2028.
It is the first round of qualifying for the 2028 European Championship.
U grupi su još Češka i Izrael.
The Czech Republic and Israel are also in the group.
Navijači iz BiH ispunili su dio dvorane i prije početka zajedno pjevali.
Fans from BiH filled part of the hall and sang together before the start.
Pjesma "Jedna si jedina" odjekivala je dvoranom, a jedna navijačica zaplakala je od emocija.
The song "Jedna si jedina" echoed through the hall, and one female fan cried from emotion.
Selektor Damir Doborac na put je išao s problemima, jer su se povrijedila četiri igrača.
Coach Damir Doborac travelled with problems, because four players were injured.
Najviše brine desna strana odbrane, gdje je jedina opcija Faris Čolaković, čije je zdravlje upitno.
The biggest worry is the right side of defence, where the only option is Faris Čolaković, whose health is in doubt.
Doborac je rekao da je Slovenija ozbiljan protivnik, ali da BiH neće unaprijed odustati.
Doborac said that Slovenia is a serious opponent, but that BiH will not give up in advance.
Kapiten Ibrahim Haseljić smatra da tim mora praviti manje tehničkih grešaka.
Captain Ibrahim Haseljić thinks the team must make fewer technical mistakes.
Sljedeću utakmicu BiH igra u nedjelju u 17:00 protiv Češke u tuzlanskoj dvorani Mejdan.
BiH plays its next match on Sunday at 17:00 against the Czech Republic in the Mejdan hall in Tuzla.

title: Đoković ispao u Parizu i neće igrati ATP Finale
Djoković is out in Paris and will not play the ATP Finals
body: Novak Đoković ispao je u osmini finala Masters turnira u Parizu.
Novak Djoković was knocked out in the round of 16 of the Masters tournament in Paris.
Pobijedio ga je Australijanac Rinky Hijikata, 83. igrač svijeta.
He was beaten by the Australian Rinky Hijikata, the 83rd player in the world.
Meč je trajao dva sata i 16 minuta.
The match lasted two hours and 16 minutes.
Đoković je bolje počeo i prvi set dobio sa 6:2.
Djoković started better and won the first set 6-2.
Nakon toga je izgubio dva seta zaredom, oba sa 3:6.
After that he lost two sets in a row, both 6-3.
Zbog tog poraza ne može više među osam najboljih igrača sezone.
Because of this defeat he can no longer be among the eight best players of the season.
To znači da neće igrati ATP Finale u Torinu.
This means he will not play the ATP Finals in Turin.
Dan ranije Đoković je pobijedio Valentina Vacherota nakon preokreta.
The day before, Djoković had beaten Valentin Vacherot after a comeback.
Tom pobjedom postao je najstariji igrač koji je pobijedio na ovom turniru.
With that win he became the oldest player to win at this tournament.
Ovaj poraz zato mnogim navijačima djeluje još razočaravajuće.
That is why this defeat seems even more disappointing to many fans.

title: Dionice Tesle i SpaceX-a pale nakon izbora u SAD-u
Tesla and SpaceX shares fell after the US elections
body: Dionice kompanija Tesla i SpaceX pale su nakon pobjede demokrata na izborima u SAD-u.
The shares of Tesla and SpaceX fell after the Democrats' win in the US elections.
Demokrate su osvojile oba doma Kongresa.
The Democrats won both houses of Congress.
Prije otvaranja berze Tesla je pala oko 5%, a SpaceX oko 6%.
Before the stock exchange opened, Tesla fell about 5% and SpaceX about 6%.
Investitori strahuju od strožih pravila za vještačku inteligenciju i od planiranog spajanja Tesle i SpaceX-a.
Investors fear stricter rules for artificial intelligence and the planned merger of Tesla and SpaceX.
Analitičarka Kathleen Brooks kaže da Kongres ne može zaustaviti spajanje, ali ga može usporiti.
Analyst Kathleen Brooks says that Congress cannot stop the merger, but it can slow it down.
Obje kompanije imaju sjedište u Teksasu, a tamo su pobijedili demokrate.
Both companies are headquartered in Texas, and the Democrats won there.
Prema izvještajima, Elon Musk potrošio je skoro 450 miliona dolara na podršku republikancima.
According to reports, Elon Musk spent almost 450 million dollars supporting the Republicans.
Dionice su porasle zdravstvenim osiguravačima i bolnicama, a Molina Healthcare skočila je skoro 7%.
Shares rose for health insurers and hospitals, and Molina Healthcare jumped almost 7%.
Porasle su i dionice obnovljive energije, dok su kompanije za vještačku inteligenciju pale.
Renewable energy shares also rose, while artificial intelligence companies fell.
Gina Hinojosa, buduća guvernerka Teksasa, obećala je da će zaustaviti odobravanje novih data-centara dok se ne usvoje nova pravila.
Gina Hinojosa, the future governor of Texas, promised to stop approving new data centers until new rules are adopted.
Terminski indeksi su porasli nakon što je Donald Trump rekao da će prihvatiti rezultate izbora.
Index futures rose after Donald Trump said he would accept the election results.

title: Novo Predsjedništvo BiH počinje rad 16. novembra
The new BiH Presidency starts work on 16 November
body: Novi saziv Predsjedništva BiH održat će prvu, konstituirajuću sjednicu u ponedjeljak, 16. novembra.
The new Presidency of BiH will hold its first, constituent session on Monday, 16 November.
Tada će novoizabrani članovi i zvanično preuzeti dužnost.
On that day the newly elected members will also officially take office.
Datum su za novinsku agenciju FENA potvrdili iz institucija.
The institutions confirmed the date to the news agency FENA.
Predsjedništvo će činiti Denis Bećirović, Darijana Filipović i Željka Cvijanović.
The Presidency will consist of Denis Bećirović, Darijana Filipović and Željka Cvijanović.
Bećirović i Cvijanović dobili su drugi uzastopni mandat od četiri godine.
Bećirović and Cvijanović won a second consecutive four-year mandate.
Darijana Filipović, kandidatkinja HDZ-a BiH, zamjenjuje Željka Komšića, dosadašnjeg člana iz reda hrvatskog naroda.
Darijana Filipović, a candidate of HDZ BiH, replaces Željko Komšić, the outgoing member from the Croat people.
Mandat novih članova traje od 2026. do 2030. godine.
The mandate of the new members runs from 2026 to 2030.
Centralna izborna komisija potvrdila je rezultate općih izbora 3. novembra.
The Central Election Commission confirmed the results of the general elections on 3 November.
Izbori su održani 4. oktobra, a potvrda stvara uslove za formiranje novih organa vlasti.
The elections were held on 4 October, and the confirmation creates the conditions for forming new government bodies.
Prema Ustavu, Predsjedništvo vodi vanjsku politiku i imenuje ambasadore.
Under the Constitution, the Presidency conducts foreign policy and appoints ambassadors.
Ono također predstavlja BiH u međunarodnim organizacijama.
It also represents BiH in international organizations.

title: Godinu dana od požara u Domu penzionera u Tuzli
One year since the fire at the retirement home in Tuzla
body: Danas je godinu dana od požara u Domu penzionera u Tuzli.
Today it is one year since the fire at the retirement home in Tuzla.
U požaru 4. novembra 2025. poginulo je 17 osoba, a više od 30 je povrijeđeno.
In the fire on 4 November 2025, 17 people died and more than 30 were injured.
Pitanje odgovornosti još uvijek nema kraj.
The question of responsibility still has no end.
Prema prvim nalazima vještaka, požar je izazvao kratki spoj na kablu radio-prijemnika.
According to the first expert findings, the fire was caused by a short circuit in the cable of a radio receiver.
Kabl je bio stisnut između madraca, zida i metalnog kreveta.
The cable was squeezed between a mattress, a wall and a metal bed.
Tužilaštvo Tuzlanskog kantona podiglo je optužnicu protiv sedam osoba zbog nemara.
The Tuzla Canton Prosecutor's Office has indicted seven people for negligence.
Među optuženima su bivši direktor doma i kantonalni inspektor za zaštitu od požara.
Among the accused are the former director of the home and a cantonal fire inspector.
Tužilaštvo traži da im se na deset godina zabrani obavljanje određenih funkcija.
The prosecutor asks that they be banned from certain functions for ten years.
U domu je bilo oko 180 štićenika, a oko 110 njih bilo je teško bolesno ili nepokretno.
There were about 180 residents in the home, and about 110 of them were seriously ill or unable to move.
Tužilaštvo tvrdi da su manjak nadzora, sistema za rano otkrivanje požara i plana evakuacije doprinijeli broju žrtava.
The prosecutor says that the lack of supervision, early fire detection and an evacuation plan contributed to the number of victims.
Kantonalna inspekcija privremeno je zabranila domu pružanje usluga socijalne zaštite.
The cantonal inspectorate temporarily banned the home from providing social protection services.
Klix.ba je pisao da dom ipak radi i da u njemu ostaje oko 100 štićenika.
Klix.ba reported that the home still operates and that about 100 residents remain there.
Iz uprave doma rekli su da je požar bio najbolniji trenutak u njihovoj historiji.
The home's management said that the fire was the most painful moment in their history.

title: Mike Johnson napušta vodstvo republikanaca u Predstavničkom domu
Mike Johnson is leaving the Republican leadership in the House
body: Predsjednik Predstavničkog doma SAD-a Mike Johnson neće ostati na čelu republikanaca u novom Kongresu.
The Speaker of the US House of Representatives Mike Johnson will not stay at the head of the Republicans in the new Congress.
To je rekao saradnicima telefonom u srijedu ujutro, samo dan nakon što su demokrate osvojile većinu u domu.
He told his staff by phone on Wednesday morning, only a day after the Democrats won the majority in the House.
Vijest su potvrdila četiri izvora koja su bila na pozivu, javlja televizija NBC.
Four sources who were on the call confirmed the news, NBC reports.
Johnson neće tražiti ni mjesto lidera manjine, pa će ta funkcija ostati upražnjena.
Johnson will not seek the post of minority leader either, so that position will remain vacant.
Republikanci u Predstavničkom domu izabrat će novo vodstvo u utorak, 10. novembra.
The Republicans in the House will elect new leadership on Tuesday, 10 November.
Johnson je predsjednik doma od 2023, kada su republikanci smijenili Kevina McCarthyja.
Johnson has been Speaker since 2023, when the Republicans removed Kevin McCarthy.
U oktobru je za CBS rekao da bi ostao na čelu stranke i ako izgubi većinu.
In October he told CBS that he would stay at the head of the party even if it lost the majority.
U utorak navečer priznao je poraz iz Shreveporta u Louisiani.
On Tuesday evening he conceded defeat from Shreveport in Louisiana.
Rekao je da je i on razočaran, kao i svaki Amerikanac koji nije zadovoljan rezultatima.
He said that he is disappointed too, like every American who is not satisfied with the results.
Predvidio je da će republikanci vratiti većinu 2028. godine.
He predicted that the Republicans will win back the majority in 2028.
Kao razlog poraza naveo je historijsku pojavu da predsjednikova stranka rijetko dobija mjesta na prvim izborima sredinom mandata.
As the reason for the defeat he named the historical pattern that the president's party rarely gains seats in the first midterm elections.

title: Toplane plaćaju 58 miliona KM za plin i struju
Heating plants pay 58 million KM for gas and electricity
body: Sarajevske Toplane izabrale su dobavljače plina i struje za iduću godinu.
The Sarajevo heating plants have chosen their gas and electricity suppliers for next year.
Ugovori su vrijedni ukupno oko 58 miliona KM bez PDV-a.
The contracts are worth about 58 million KM in total, without VAT.
Na oba tendera stigla je samo jedna ponuda, i to od javnih preduzeća.
Only one bid arrived at both tenders, and it came from public companies.
Plin će isporučivati Sarajevogas, a ugovor vrijedi 55,4 miliona KM.
Sarajevogas will deliver the gas, and the contract is worth 55.4 million KM.
Procijenjena vrijednost bila je 60 miliona KM, pa je ponuda oko 7,7 posto niža.
The estimated value was 60 million KM, so the bid is about 7.7 percent lower.
Struju će isporučivati Elektroprivreda BiH za 2,75 miliona KM, što je skoro isto kao procjena.
Elektroprivreda BiH will deliver the electricity for 2.75 million KM, which is almost the same as the estimate.
Prošli ugovor iz januara bio je oko 350.000 KM jeftiniji.
The previous contract from January was about 350,000 KM cheaper.
Konkurencija je bila veća kod lož-ulja, gdje je stiglo šest ponuda.
There was more competition for heating oil, where six bids arrived.
Posao je dobila firma Hifa Petrol s ponudom od 749.840 KM.
The company Hifa Petrol won the job with a bid of 749,840 KM.
Toplane su od početka godine provele 145 nabavki.
Since the start of the year, the heating plants have run 145 procurements.
Čak 84 od njih dodijeljene su jedinom ponuđaču.
As many as 84 of them were given to the only bidder.

title: Silver bi skratio NBA utakmice na 40 minuta
Silver would like to shorten NBA games to 40 minutes
body: Komesar NBA lige Adam Silver navodno bi želio skratiti utakmice s 48 na 40 minuta.
NBA commissioner Adam Silver reportedly would like to shorten games from 48 to 40 minutes.
Taj podatak je objavio novinar Chris Mannix iz časopisa Sports Illustrated.
This information was published by journalist Chris Mannix of Sports Illustrated.
Liga zvanično nije predložila nikakvu promjenu, pa i dalje važe četiri četvrtine od po 12 minuta.
The league has not officially proposed any change, so four quarters of 12 minutes each still apply.
Silver bi preferirao četiri četvrtine od po 10 minuta, kao u FIBA takmičenjima i Euroligi.
Silver would prefer four quarters of 10 minutes each, as in FIBA competitions and the EuroLeague.
Rasprava se vratila nakon niza povreda zvijezda na početku sezone 2026/27.
The debate came back after a series of star injuries at the start of the 2026/27 season.
Mannix sumnja da je promjena izvodljiva, najviše zbog novca.
Mannix doubts that the change is feasible, mostly because of money.
Upozorava i da zvijezde ne bi igrale manje, a rezervisti bi dobili još manje prilike.
He also warns that stars would not play less, and the bench players would get even fewer chances.
Većina igrača je protiv ideje.
Most players are against the idea.
U martovskoj anketi portala The Athletic 78,4 posto od 153 igrača odbilo je kraće četvrtine.
In a March survey by The Athletic, 78.4 percent of 153 players rejected shorter quarters.
Samo 13,1 posto ih je podržalo.
Only 13.1 percent supported it.
Trenere Toma Thibodeaua i Michaela Malonea takođe ne oduševljava ta ideja.
Coaches Tom Thibodeau and Michael Malone are not thrilled by the idea either.

title: Evropska komisija: BiH se sve više udaljava od EU
European Commission: BiH is moving ever further from the EU
body: Evropska komisija objavila je novi izvještaj o napretku Bosne i Hercegovine.
The European Commission has published a new progress report on Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Prema izvještaju, zemlja se sve više udaljava od evropskog puta.
According to the report, the country is moving further and further from the European path.
Napretka nema u pravosuđu, borbi protiv korupcije, slobodi medija i ekonomiji.
There is no progress in the judiciary, the fight against corruption, media freedom and the economy.
Komisija posebno kritikuje vizni režim jer je BiH produžila sezonska oslobađanja od viza s 30 na 60 dana.
The Commission especially criticizes the visa regime because BiH extended seasonal visa exemptions from 30 to 60 days.
Brisel traži da se vize uvedu za državljane Rusije, Kine, Turske i Katara.
Brussels wants visas to be introduced for citizens of Russia, China, Turkey and Qatar.
Parlament je donio samo 12 zakona, a zemlja i dalje nema glavnog pregovarača s EU.
Parliament passed only 12 laws, and the country still has no chief negotiator with the EU.
Privredni rast usporio je na 1,7 posto, a nezaposlenost je 12,2 posto.
Economic growth slowed to 1.7 percent, and unemployment is 12.2 percent.
Među mladima je nezaposleno čak 32,9 posto ljudi.
Among young people, as many as 32.9 percent are unemployed.
BiH je 19. juna dospjela na sivu listu FATF-a zbog slabe borbe protiv pranja novca.
On 19 June BiH ended up on the FATF grey list because of a weak fight against money laundering.
Ako uslovi ne budu ispunjeni do kraja godine, zemlja bi mogla izgubiti do 976,6 miliona eura.
If the conditions are not met by the end of the year, the country could lose up to 976.6 million euros.
Izvještaj upozorava i da javni servis BHRT prijeti gašenje.
The report also warns that the public broadcaster BHRT faces shutdown.

title: Roboti osam sati radili u Xiaomijevoj fabrici
Robots worked eight hours in Xiaomi's factory
body: Kompanija Xiaomi objavila je snimak na kojem dva humanoidna robota rade u fabrici automobila.
The company Xiaomi has published a video in which two humanoid robots work in a car factory.
Roboti su osam sati sortirali dijelove za bočne poklopce središnje konzole.
The robots sorted parts for the side covers of the center console for eight hours.
Dijelove su vadili iz velikih kontejnera i slagali ih na police.
They took the parts out of big containers and placed them on shelves.
Xiaomi tvrdi da roboti sami primjećuju i ispravljaju greške te da rade u skladu s proizvodnom linijom.
Xiaomi claims that the robots notice and correct mistakes by themselves and work in step with the production line.
Snimak je ubrzan i do 100 puta.
The video is sped up by up to 100 times.
Kompanija nije objavila koliko je dijelova sortirano niti koliko su često ljudi morali pomoći.
The company has not said how many parts were sorted or how often people had to help.
Nije jasno ni kako su se roboti punili strujom.
It is also not clear how the robots were charged.
U martu je Xiaomi javio da je robot montirao matice s uspješnošću od 90,2 posto, a u julu s 98 posto.
In March Xiaomi reported that a robot installed nuts with a 90.2 percent success rate, and in July with 98 percent.
Robot je predstavljen u augustu u Pekingu i još je prototip.
The robot was presented in August in Beijing and is still a prototype.
Audi već testira slične robote u Ingolstadtu, a BMW razmišlja o njima.
Audi is already testing similar robots in Ingolstadt, and BMW is thinking about them.

title: Bijelo dugme rasprodalo pola Zetre
Bijelo Dugme has sold half of Zetra
body: Za koncert grupe Bijelo dugme u Sarajevu prodana je otprilike polovina ulaznica.
About half of the tickets have been sold for the Bijelo Dugme concert in Sarajevo.
Koncert će biti u dvorani Zetra 27. marta 2027.
The concert will be in the Zetra hall on 27 March 2027.
Do tada ima još skoro pet mjeseci, kažu organizatori.
There are still almost five months until then, say the organizers.
Sarajevski nastup jedan je od posljednjih na turneji „Doživjeti stotu“.
The Sarajevo show is one of the last on the tour "Doživjeti stotu".
Turneja obilježava 50 godina rada grupe i već je obuhvatila niz velikih koncerata u regiji.
The tour marks 50 years of the band's work and has already included a series of big concerts in the region.
Na sceni će biti Goran, Zoran, Tifa, Alen, Điđi i Ognjen, a s njima i prijatelji.
On stage will be Goran, Zoran, Tifa, Alen, Điđi and Ognjen, together with friends.
Organizatori očekuju posjetioce iz drugih bh. gradova i iz cijele regije.
The organizers expect visitors from other Bosnian cities and from the whole region.
Članovi grupe i njihov producent više puta su rekli da je povratak u Sarajevo prirodan korak.
The band members and their producer have said several times that returning to Sarajevo is a natural step.
U tom gradu je grupa i nastala.
The band was formed in that city.
Koncert organizuje firma Travel 4 Fun, a ulaznice se prodaju preko stranice ulaznica.org.
The concert is organized by the company Travel 4 Fun, and tickets are sold through the website ulaznica.org.

title: Ljekar koji je pomagao u BiH ulazi u Kongres
A doctor who helped in BiH is entering Congress
body: Adam Hamawy, hirurg koji je pomagao ranjenicima u BiH i Gazi, izabran je u američki Kongres.
Adam Hamawy, a surgeon who helped wounded people in BiH and Gaza, has been elected to the US Congress.
Demokrata je pobijedio u 12. izbornom okrugu savezne države New Jersey.
The Democrat won in the 12th congressional district of New Jersey.
Prema djelimičnim rezultatima, dobio je oko 70 posto glasova, a republikanac Gregg Mele oko 28 posto.
According to partial results, he got about 70 percent of the votes, and the Republican Gregg Mele about 28 percent.
Hamawy će naslijediti Bonnie Watson Coleman, koja odlazi u penziju.
Hamawy will succeed Bonnie Watson Coleman, who is retiring.
Prema New Jersey Globeu, prvi je musliman iz te države u Kongresu.
According to the New Jersey Globe, he is the first Muslim from that state in Congress.
Rođen je u Egiptu, a u New Jersey je došao kao beba.
He was born in Egypt and came to New Jersey as a baby.
Studirao je medicinu, osam godina je služio u vojsci i radio je kao vojni hirurg u Iraku.
He studied medicine, served eight years in the army and worked as a military surgeon in Iraq.
Više od 30 godina volontira u ratnim zonama, među ostalim u Bosni 1995. godine.
For more than 30 years he has volunteered in war zones, among others in Bosnia in 1995.
U maju 2024. volontirao je u bolnici u Khan Younisu u Gazi.
In May 2024 he volunteered at a hospital in Khan Younis in Gaza.
Zaglavio je kada je Izrael zatvorio prijelaz Rafah, a pomoć su tražili i američki političari.
He got stuck when Israel closed the Rafah crossing, and American politicians also asked for help.
Njegov slogan u kampanji bio je „zdravstvo, a ne bombe“.
His campaign slogan was "healthcare, not bombs".

title: Džanan Musa igrao košarku na vrhu nebodera u Dubaiju
Džanan Musa played basketball on top of a skyscraper in Dubai
body: Košarkaš Džanan Musa i njegov saigrač Justin Anderson snimili su neobičan video na krovu nebodera u Dubaiju.
Basketball player Džanan Musa and his teammate Justin Anderson filmed an unusual video on the roof of a skyscraper in Dubai.
Klub Dubai Basketball objavio ga je na svom Instagram profilu.
The club Dubai Basketball posted it on its Instagram profile.
Igrali su na heliodromu na visini od 303 metra, a iza koša vidi se Burj Khalifa, najviša zgrada na svijetu.
They played on a helipad at a height of 303 metres, and behind the hoop you can see the Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world.
Na snimku se Musa prvo zagrijava s loptom, a zatim zajedno s Andersonom pokazuje nekoliko poteza.
In the video, Musa first warms up with a ball, and then shows several moves together with Anderson.
Anderson zakuca loptu dok je u pozadini Burj Khalifa.
Anderson dunks the ball with the Burj Khalifa in the background.
Snimanje se nastavlja i poslije zalaska sunca, pa igrači šutiraju pod reflektorima, a ispred njih je svjetlo grada.
Filming continues after sunset, so the players shoot under floodlights, with the lights of the city in front of them.
Na kraju dronovi na nebu oblikuju grb kluba.
At the end, drones form the club crest in the sky.
Video je zajednički projekat kluba i kompanije Red Bull, što pokazuje i opis uz objavu.
The video is a joint project of the club and the company Red Bull, which the caption of the post also shows.
Musa se krajem oktobra oporavio od povrede.
Musa recovered from an injury at the end of October.
Dubai je u ponedjeljak u ABA ligi pobijedio Zadar, a ranije je kod kuće savladao i Hapoel u Euroligi.
On Monday, Dubai beat Zadar in the ABA League, and earlier it also beat Hapoel at home in the EuroLeague.

title: Kiša u BiH danas staje, slijede vedriji dani i hladna jutra
Rain in BiH stops today, clearer days and cold mornings follow
body: Slaba kiša u Bosni danas bi trebala stati do podne.
Light rain in Bosnia should stop by noon today.
Prema prognozi Federalnog hidrometeorološkog zavoda, do vikenda se ne očekuju nove padavine u većem dijelu zemlje.
According to the forecast of the Federal Hydrometeorological Institute, no new precipitation is expected in most of the country until the weekend.
Prije podne je moguć i slab snijeg na planinama.
Before noon, weak snow is also possible in the mountains.
Danas će u Bosni i sjevernoj Hercegovini biti oblačno, a u većem dijelu Hercegovine sunčanije.
Today it will be cloudy in Bosnia and northern Herzegovina, and sunnier in most of Herzegovina.
Temperature će u Bosni biti od 4 do 10 stepeni, a na jugu do 18.
Temperatures in Bosnia will be from 4 to 10 degrees, and up to 18 in the south.
U Sarajevu se ujutro očekuje oko 6 stepeni, a preko dana oko 8.
In Sarajevo, about 6 degrees are expected in the morning and about 8 during the day.
U četvrtak i petak bit će sunčano u Hercegovini, dok će u dijelu Bosne ostati dosta niskih oblaka.
On Thursday and Friday it will be sunny in Herzegovina, while a lot of low cloud will remain in parts of Bosnia.
Najveća promjena stiže u subotu, kada se očekuje najhladnije jutro ove sedmice.
The biggest change arrives on Saturday, when the coldest morning of this week is expected.
Temperatura će ponegdje pasti ispod nule, a u Sarajevu bi mogla biti oko 0 stepeni.
The temperature will drop below zero in some places, and in Sarajevo it could be around 0 degrees.
Preko dana će biti od 7 do 12 stepeni, a na jugu do 16.
During the day it will be from 7 to 12 degrees, and up to 16 in the south.
U Trebinju se u drugom dijelu dana očekuje kiša.
In Trebinje, rain is expected in the second part of the day.

title: Energetska pića povezana sa srčanim problemima kod mladih
Energy drinks linked to heart problems in young people
body: Nova analiza Američkog udruženja za srce povezuje energetska pića s češćim srčanim zastojem i infarktom.
A new analysis by the American Heart Association links energy drinks to more frequent cardiac arrest and heart attack.
Isto vrijedi za dodatke prehrani koji sadrže kofein i druge stimulanse.
The same applies to dietary supplements that contain caffeine and other stimulants.
Najviše prijava dolazi od osoba između 18 i 34 godine.
Most reports come from people between 18 and 34 years old.
Istraživači su pregledali 28.345 prijava štetnih događaja koje je američka agencija FDA primila od 2017. do 2025. godine.
Researchers reviewed 28,345 reports of adverse events that the American agency FDA received from 2017 to 2025.
U 854 prijave bili su uključeni energetski napici ili takvi dodaci.
In 854 reports, energy drinks or such supplements were involved.
Srčani zastoj prijavljivan je oko 11 puta češće nego kod proizvoda bez tih sastojaka, a infarkt oko 4,5 puta češće.
Cardiac arrest was reported about 11 times more often than with products without these ingredients, and heart attack about 4.5 times more often.
Oko 45 posto prijava odnosilo se na osobe od 18 do 34 godine, koje se obično ne smatraju rizičnom grupom.
About 45 percent of the reports concerned people aged 18 to 34, who are usually not considered a risk group.
Autori naglašavaju da rezultati pokazuju samo vezu, a ne dokaz da su proizvodi izazvali probleme.
The authors stress that the results show only a link, not proof that the products caused the problems.
Prijave FDA su dobrovoljne, pa se ne zna koliko je ljudi popilo ova pića bez posljedica.
FDA reports are voluntary, so it is not known how many people drank these drinks without consequences.
Za većinu odraslih bezbjedno je do 400 mg kofeina dnevno, otprilike pet šoljica kafe.
For most adults, up to 400 mg of caffeine per day is safe, roughly five cups of coffee.
Ljekari bi, prema autorima, trebali pitati mlade s lupanjem srca ili bolom u grudima piju li redovno energetska pića.
According to the authors, doctors should ask young people with a racing heart or chest pain whether they regularly drink energy drinks.

title: Teksas nakon 36 godina bira demokratsku guvernerku
After 36 years, Texas elects a Democratic governor
body: Demokratkinja Gina Hinojosa pobijedila je republikanca Grega Abbotta na izborima za guvernera Teksasa.
Democrat Gina Hinojosa defeated Republican Greg Abbott in the election for governor of Texas.
Prema projekciji agencije AP, ona je prva Latinoamerikanka na čelu Teksasa.
According to an AP projection, she is the first Latina to lead Texas.
Ujedno je prva demokratska guvernerka izabrana u toj državi od 1990. godine.
She is also the first Democratic governor elected in that state since 1990.
Prema neslužbenim rezultatima, Hinojosa je dobila 4.357.768 glasova, a Abbott 3.740.819.
According to unofficial results, Hinojosa got 4,357,768 votes and Abbott 3,740,819.
Razlika je veća od 600.000 glasova.
The difference is more than 600,000 votes.
Abbott je priznao poraz nekoliko sati nakon zatvaranja birališta.
Abbott conceded defeat a few hours after the polls closed.
Rekao je da još ima glasova za prebrojavanje, ali da matematički ne mogu pobijediti.
He said there were still votes to count, but that mathematically they could not win.
Na čelu Teksasa bio je od 2015. godine.
He had led Texas since 2015.
Hinojosa je advokatica za radno pravo i od 2017. je zastupnica u parlamentu Teksasa.
Hinojosa is a labour-law attorney and has been a member of the Texas legislature since 2017.
U kampanji se bavila troškovima života i javnim obrazovanjem.
In her campaign she focused on the cost of living and public education.
Obećala je da će koristiti pravo veta, među ostalim protiv novih izbornih mapa u korist jedne stranke.
She promised to use her veto power, among other things against new electoral maps in favour of one party.
Dužnost preuzima u januaru 2027. godine.
She takes office in January 2027.

title: Sindikati traže minimalnu platu od 1.500 KM do kraja godine
Unions demand a minimum wage of 1,500 KM by the end of the year
body: Savez samostalnih sindikata BiH formalno će predložiti da minimalna plata u Federaciji bude najmanje 1.500 KM.
The Confederation of Independent Trade Unions of BiH will formally propose that the minimum wage in the Federation be at least 1,500 KM.
To je u emisiji na TVSA potvrdio predsjednik Saveza Samir Kurtović.
The president of the Confederation, Samir Kurtović, confirmed this on the show on TVSA.
Prijedlog će poslati Ekonomsko-socijalnom vijeću i traži hitnu sjednicu.
He will send the proposal to the Economic-Social Council and is asking for an urgent session.
Kurtović kaže da radnici s današnjim platama ne mogu pratiti rast cijena.
Kurtović says that workers on today's wages cannot keep up with rising prices.
Podsjetio je da minimalna plata u Hrvatskoj iznosi oko 1.130 eura, a u EU između 1.200 i 1.400 eura.
He reminded that the minimum wage in Croatia is about 1,130 euros, and in the EU between 1,200 and 1,400 euros.
Cijene u EU su, prema njegovim riječima, gotovo iste kao u BiH.
Prices in the EU are, according to him, almost the same as in BiH.
Zato radnici odlaze u inostranstvo, gdje mogu zaraditi otprilike duplo više.
That is why workers are leaving for abroad, where they can earn roughly double.
Sindikat ne želi prijedlog zakona po kojem bi minimalac iznosio 70 posto prosječne plate.
The union does not want the draft law under which the minimum wage would be 70 percent of the average wage.
Smatra da to odgovara samo radnicima s osnovnom školom, pa traži jasne platne razrede prema obrazovanju.
It believes this suits only workers with primary education, so it demands clear pay grades according to education.
Razgovor s Vladom FBiH i poslodavcima očekuje se sljedeće sedmice.
A meeting with the Federation Government and employers is expected next week.
Sindikat želi da se pregovori završe do kraja godine jer, kako kaže, radnici ne mogu čekati.
The union wants the talks to end by the end of the year because, as it says, workers cannot wait.

title: CT skener otkrio šifru katanca s brodoloma iz 16. stoljeća
CT scanner reveals the code of a padlock from a 16th-century shipwreck
body: Naučnici su pomoću 3D skeniranja otkrili šifru mjedenog katanca starog oko 400 godina.
Scientists used 3D scanning to discover the code of a brass padlock about 400 years old.
Katanac je pronađen na obali Velsa, a šifra se sastoji od četiri slova: ANCE.
The padlock was found on the coast of Wales, and the code consists of four letters: ANCE.
Analizu su radili stručnjaci s Univerziteta u Cardiffu i Nacionalnog muzeja Velsa.
The analysis was done by experts from Cardiff University and the National Museum Wales.
Katanac je 1999. godine metal-detektorom pronašao Peter Hughes, koji je tada imao 69 godina.
The padlock was found in 1999 with a metal detector by Peter Hughes, who was 69 years old at the time.
Pripadao je teretu trgovačkog broda Ann Francis, koji je u oluji potonuo 28. decembra 1583.
It belonged to the cargo of the merchant ship Ann Francis, which sank in a storm on 28 December 1583.
Hughes je oko 20 godina pokušavao otvoriti katanac okretanjem koturića, ali nije uspio.
For about 20 years Hughes tried to open the padlock by turning the dials, but he did not succeed.
Brava ima četiri prstena sa po šest slova, što daje 1.296 mogućih kombinacija.
The lock has four rings with six letters each, which gives 1,296 possible combinations.
David Williams je koristio industrijski mikro-CT skener, koji može pogledati unutar metala bez oštećenja.
David Williams used an industrial micro-CT scanner, which can look inside metal without damaging it.
Prvo skeniranje iznenadilo je tim jer su se unutar mehanizma vidjela slova.
The first scan surprised the team because letters could be seen inside the mechanism.
Drugo skeniranje nije uspjelo, a tek treći pokušaj dao je čitljivu šifru.
The second scan failed, and only the third attempt gave a readable code.
Katanac je izložen u Muzeju obale u Swanseaju, zajedno s ostalim predmetima s broda.
The padlock is on display in the Museum of the Coast in Swansea, together with other items from the ship.

title: Dojava o bombi na izraelskom kruzeru u Grčkoj
Bomb threat on an Israeli cruise ship in Greece
body: Grčka obalska straža pretražuje izraelski kruzer Crown Iris u luci na ostrvu Siros.
The Greek coast guard is searching the Israeli cruise ship Crown Iris in a port on the island of Syros.
Nepoznata osoba dojavila je da je na trup broda postavljena eksplozivna naprava.
An unknown person reported that an explosive device had been placed on the ship's hull.
Brod vodi izraelska kompanija Mano Maritime, a plovi pod zastavom Paname.
The ship is run by the Israeli company Mano Maritime, and it sails under the flag of Panama.
Kruzer je trebao ploviti prema Hajfi u Izraelu, a na njemu je 940 putnika i 597 članova posade.
The cruise ship was due to sail to Haifa in Israel, and it has 940 passengers and 597 crew members on board.
Zbog mjera sigurnosti zadržano je ukupno 1.537 ljudi.
Because of the security measures, a total of 1,537 people were held.
Obalska straža pretražila je brod psom za otkrivanje eksploziva, a pomogao im je i privatni ronilac.
The coast guard searched the ship with an explosives-detection dog, and a private diver helped them.
Na mjesto događaja poslana je i posebna jedinica.
A special unit was also sent to the scene.
Prvi pregled nije pronašao nikakvu eksplozivnu napravu.
The first inspection did not find any explosive device.
Stručnjaci obalske straže trebali bi doći oko 20:30 po bosanskom vremenu i obaviti dodatne provjere.
Coast guard specialists should arrive at about 20:30 Bosnian time and carry out further checks.
Ako ništa ne pronađu, brod bi mogao nastaviti putovanje.
If they find nothing, the ship could continue its voyage.
Prijetnje bombom prijavljene su i za najmanje sedam letova u Evropi, ali ni tamo nije pronađen eksploziv.
Bomb threats were also reported for at least seven flights in Europe, but no explosives were found there either.

title: Vodovod i stanovnici dogovorili kako će se vršiti redukcije vode
The water utility and residents agreed how water cuts will be carried out
body: Sarajevski Vodovod i kanalizacija (ViK) dogovorio je sa stanovnicima pet naselja kako će se vršiti redukcije vode.
The Sarajevo water utility (ViK) agreed with residents of five neighbourhoods how water reductions will be carried out.
Riječ je o naseljima Pogledine, Širokača, Komatin, Jarčedoli i Mahmutovac.
These are the neighbourhoods of Pogledine, Širokača, Komatin, Jarčedoli and Mahmutovac.
Redukcije će trajati dok traju nepovoljne hidrološke prilike, odnosno dok se stanje na izvorima ne stabilizira.
The reductions will last as long as the unfavourable hydrological conditions last, that is, until the situation at the water sources becomes stable.
ViK kaže da će pokušati rasporediti dostupnu vodu što racionalnije i svim korisnicima osigurati najbolje moguće snabdijevanje.
ViK says it will try to distribute the available water as sensibly as possible and give all users the best possible supply.
Dogovoreno je i da će se uspostaviti direktna komunikacija preko imenovanih kontakt osoba.
It was also agreed that direct communication will be set up through named contact persons.
Tako bi stanovnici bili na vrijeme obaviješteni, a problemi na terenu rješavali bi se brže.
This way residents would be informed in time, and problems on the ground would be solved faster.
Redukcije vode u Kantonu Sarajevo traju već sedmicama, a ViK navodi da je stanje na izvorima loše nakon višemjesečne suše.
Water reductions in Sarajevo Canton have been going on for weeks, and ViK says the situation at the sources is poor after a drought lasting several months.
Stanovnici Jarčedola i Pogledina danas su protestovali ispred direkcije ViK-a.
Residents of Jarčedoli and Pogledine protested today in front of the ViK headquarters.
Rekli su da mjesecima nemaju redovnu vodu, pogotovo noću.
They said that for months they have not had regular water, especially at night.
Dodali su da računi i dalje stižu kao i prije.
They added that the bills still arrive as before.

title: Tužilaštvo u Rimu preuzelo crnu kutiju helikoptera EUFOR-a
Prosecutors in Rome took the black box of the EUFOR helicopter
body: Tužilaštvo u Rimu preuzelo je crnu kutiju helikoptera Chinook koji se srušio kod Brčkog.
The prosecutor's office in Rome has taken over the black box of the Chinook helicopter that crashed near Brčko.
Uređaj je zabilježio cijeli let, kretanje helikoptera i sve podatke o njegovom radu.
The device recorded the whole flight, the movement of the helicopter and all data about its operation.
Stručnjaci italijanskog Ministarstva odbrane pregledat će ga u okviru opsežne istrage.
Experts of the Italian Ministry of Defence will examine it as part of a broad investigation.
Helikopter misije EUFOR Althea trebao je sletjeti na brčansku pistu da bi se promijenili piloti.
The helicopter of the EUFOR Althea mission was supposed to land on the Brčko airstrip so that the pilots could be changed.
Prilikom polijetanja izgubio je visinu i udario u tlo.
During takeoff it lost altitude and hit the ground.
Poginula su četiri italijanska pripadnika EUFOR-a, a jedna narednica preminula je u bolnici.
Four Italian members of EUFOR died, and one sergeant died in hospital.
Obdukcija u Rimu potvrdila je da su uzrok smrti teške povrede.
The autopsy in Rome confirmed that the cause of death was severe injuries.
Tužilac Francesco Saverio Musolino ponovo će saslušati preživjele čim im zdravlje to dopusti.
Prosecutor Francesco Saverio Musolino will question the survivors again as soon as their health allows.
Italijanska policija već je razgovarala s dijelom svjedoka i s trojicom pilota koji su bili u helikopteru.
Italian police have already spoken with some of the witnesses and with the three pilots who were in the helicopter.
Prema agenciji ANSA, glavna pretpostavka je tehnički kvar, jer su oba pilota imala iste komande.
According to the agency ANSA, the main assumption is a technical malfunction, because both pilots had the same controls.
Vojno tužilaštvo u Rimu otvorilo je i slučaj protiv nepoznatih osoba zbog sumnje na nemarno gubljenje letjelice.
The military prosecutor's office in Rome has also opened a case against unknown persons over suspected negligent loss of the aircraft.

title: Statham i Ritchie opet zajedno snimaju triler "Dogfight"
Statham and Ritchie make the thriller "Dogfight" together again
body: Netflix je najavio akcijski triler "Dogfight", a režira ga Guy Ritchie, dok glavnu ulogu igra Jason Statham.
Netflix has announced the action thriller "Dogfight", which is directed by Guy Ritchie, while Jason Statham plays the main role.
To je njihov sedmi zajednički film.
It is their seventh film together.
Netflix ga opisuje kao akcijski film o osveti u londonskom kriminalnom podzemlju.
Netflix describes it as an action film about revenge in London's criminal underworld.
Snimanje u Velikoj Britaniji počinje početkom 2027. godine.
Filming in the United Kingdom starts at the beginning of 2027.
Datum premijere i ostatak glumačke ekipe još nisu objavljeni.
The premiere date and the rest of the cast have not been announced yet.
Ritchie piše scenarij, režira i producira, a Statham je i producent.
Ritchie writes the script, directs and produces, and Statham is also a producer.
Film proizvode kompanije Black Bear Pictures, Toff Guy Films i Punch Palace Productions.
The film is produced by the companies Black Bear Pictures, Toff Guy Films and Punch Palace Productions.
Njihova saradnja počela je 1998. filmom "Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels", Ritchiejevim redateljskim debijem.
Their cooperation began in 1998 with the film "Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels", Ritchie's directing debut.
Za Stathama je to bila prva filmska uloga.
For Statham it was the first film role.
Zajedno su kasnije snimili i "Snatch", "Revolver" i "Wrath of Man".
Later they also made "Snatch", "Revolver" and "Wrath of Man" together.
Prije "Dogfighta" izaći će njihov film "Viva La Madness", nastavak filma "Layer Cake".
Before "Dogfight", their film "Viva La Madness", a sequel to "Layer Cake", will come out.

title: Đoković preokretom do pobjede i rekorda u Parizu
Đoković wins with a comeback and sets a record in Paris
body: Novak Đoković pobijedio je Valentina Vacherota iz Monaka rezultatom 2:1 u prvom kolu Mastersa u Parizu.
Novak Đoković beat Valentin Vacherot of Monaco 2:1 in the first round of the Masters in Paris.
Set rezultati bili su 6:7, 7:5 i 6:1, a meč je trajao oko dva i po sata.
The set scores were 6:7, 7:5 and 6:1, and the match lasted about two and a half hours.
Sa 39 godina Đoković je najstariji igrač koji je ikad dobio meč na ovom turniru.
At 39, Đoković is the oldest player who has ever won a match at this tournament.
U prvom setu spasio je tri set lopte pri rezultatu 5:6, a u taj-brejku je vodio 5:3.
In the first set he saved three set points at 5:6, and in the tiebreak he led 5:3.
Ipak, Vacherot je osvojio zadnja četiri poena i dobio set.
Still, Vacherot won the last four points and took the set.
U drugom setu Vacherot je poveo 2:0, ali je Đoković uzvratio brejkom, spasio tri brejk lopte kod 4:4 i set dobio brejkom kod 6:5.
In the second set Vacherot went ahead 2:0, but Đoković answered with a break, saved three break points at 4:4 and won the set with a break at 6:5.
U trećem setu brzo je poveo 4:0 i završio meč.
In the third set he quickly went ahead 4:0 and finished the match.
Time je prestigao Jimmyja Connorsa, koji je 1991. također pobijedio u Parizu sa 39 godina.
With this he passed Jimmy Connors, who also won in Paris at the age of 39 in 1991.
Bila je to njegova 51. pobjeda na ovom turniru i prva na Mastersu od marta u Indian Wellsu.
It was his 51st win at this tournament and his first at a Masters event since March in Indian Wells.
Prije toga je izgubio četiri meča zaredom na ovom nivou, što je njegova najduža takva serija.
Before that he had lost four matches in a row at this level, which is his longest such streak.
Sljedeći protivnik mu je australijski kvalifikant Rinky Hijikata.
His next opponent is the Australian qualifier Rinky Hijikata.
Da bi ostao u borbi za ATP Finale u Torinu, mora doći bar do polufinala.
To stay in the race for the ATP Finals in Turin, he has to reach at least the semifinals.

title: Za novu fiskalizaciju u Federaciji BiH planirano 42,3 miliona KM
42.3 million KM planned for new fiscalisation in the Federation of BiH
body: Federalno ministarstvo finansija u planu nabavki za 2026. predvidjelo je 42,3 miliona KM za novi sistem fiskalizacije.
In its procurement plan for 2026, the Federal Ministry of Finance planned 42.3 million KM for a new fiscalisation system.
Novac dolazi iz budžeta Porezne uprave FBiH, a nabavka će ići kroz otvoreni postupak s ugovorom na godinu dana.
The money comes from the budget of the FBiH Tax Administration, and the purchase will go through an open procedure with a one-year contract.
Tender za sada nije objavljen.
The tender has not been published so far.
Zakon o fiskalizaciji transakcija prelazi s klasičnih fiskalnih kasa na softverske sisteme.
The Law on Fiscalisation of Transactions moves from classic fiscal cash registers to software systems.
Ti sistemi u realnom vremenu šalju podatke o prometu Poreznoj upravi, pa bi se smanjila siva ekonomija.
These systems send turnover data to the Tax Administration in real time, so the grey economy would be reduced.
Parlament FBiH usvojio je zakon u januaru 2026, a u Službenom glasniku objavljen je u martu.
The FBiH Parliament adopted the law in January 2026, and it was published in the Official Gazette in March.
Ministar mora donijeti podzakonske akte u roku od 180 dana, ali ih početkom oktobra još nije bilo.
The minister has to adopt the bylaws within 180 days, but at the beginning of October they were still not there.
Prema izvorima Klixa, koalicioni partneri se spore oko toga koja firma treba provesti fiskalizaciju.
According to Klix sources, the coalition partners disagree about which company should carry out the fiscalisation.
Spor se uglavnom odnosi na nabavku i održavanje softvera.
The dispute mostly concerns the purchase and maintenance of the software.
U Republici Srpskoj Porezna uprava već je dodijelila održavanje svog sistema vrijedno 10,8 miliona KM, a stigla je samo jedna ponuda.
In Republika Srpska the Tax Administration has already awarded the maintenance of its system worth 10.8 million KM, and only one bid arrived.

title: Zašto večeras nema utakmica u NBA ligi
Why there are no games in the NBA tonight
body: Večeras u NBA ligi nema nijedne utakmice, jer se u utorak, 3. novembra, u Americi održavaju izbori za Kongres.
There are no NBA games tonight, because elections for Congress are held in America on Tuesday, 3 November.
Liga je namjerno ostavila ovaj dan slobodnim da bi navijači i košarkaška zajednica mogli otići na glasanje.
The league deliberately left this day free so that fans and the basketball community could go and vote.
Svi timovi imaju slobodno veče nakon ponedjeljka, kada je igran pun program utakmica.
All teams have the evening off after Monday, when a full slate of games was played.
Luka Dončić je u ponedjeljak postigao 42 poena i imao 13 asistencija, a Lakersi su pobijedili Heat.
On Monday Luka Dončić scored 42 points and had 13 assists, and the Lakers beat the Heat.
Liga je još prilikom objave rasporeda za sezonu 2026/27 najavila da na Dan izbora neće biti utakmica.
When it released the schedule for the 2026/27 season, the league already announced that there would be no games on Election Day.
Prema Yahoo Sportsu, cilj je da navijačima, igračima i osoblju bude lakše doći do biračkih mjesta.
According to Yahoo Sports, the goal is to make it easier for fans, players and staff to reach polling places.
Nakon što ove sezone više nema pauze, igra se ponovo u srijedu, 4. novembra.
Play resumes on Wednesday, 4 November.
NBA je ovu praksu počela 2022. godine, kada je prvi put preskočila Dan izbora u godini srednjoročnih izbora.
The NBA began this practice in 2022, when it first skipped Election Day in a midterm election year.
Nastavila je i 2023. i 2024. godine.
It continued in 2023 and 2024.
Prošle godine su se utakmice igrale na Dan izbora, pa je ovo četvrti put u pet godina da liga pravi takvu pauzu.
Last year games were played on Election Day, so this is the fourth time in five years that the league takes such a break.

title: Žene u Hrvatskoj od 1. januara tri mjeseca duže čekaju penziju
Women in Croatia wait three months longer for a pension from 1 January
body: Od 1. januara 2027. u Hrvatskoj se mijenjaju uslovi za odlazak žena u penziju, pa će one čekati tri mjeseca duže.
From 1 January 2027 the conditions for women to retire change in Croatia, so they will wait three months longer.
Za redovnu starosnu penziju žene će tada trebati 64 godine i 3 mjeseca života te 15 godina staža.
For a regular old-age pension women will then need 64 years and 3 months of age and 15 years of service.
Ove godine je dovoljno 64 godine i 15 godina staža.
This year 64 years and 15 years of service are enough.
Za raniju penziju trebat će 59 godina i 3 mjeseca života te 34 godine i 3 mjeseca staža.
For an early pension they will need 59 years and 3 months of age and 34 years and 3 months of service.
Granica će rasti i dalje: u 2028. na 64 godine i 6 mjeseci, a u 2029. na 64 godine i 9 mjeseci.
The limit will keep rising: to 64 years and 6 months in 2028 and to 64 years and 9 months in 2029.
Od 1. januara 2030. žene i muškarci imat će iste uslove, a to je 65 godina života i 15 godina staža.
From 1 January 2030 women and men will have the same conditions: 65 years of age and 15 years of service.
Žene koje su ispunile uslove po ranijim pravilima zadržavaju svoja prava.
Women who met the conditions under the earlier rules keep their rights.
U BiH se starosna granica za žene ne povećava svake godine.
In BiH the age limit for women does not rise every year.
I u Federaciji BiH i u Republici Srpskoj starosna penzija ostvaruje se sa 65 godina života i najmanje 15 godina staža.
Both in the Federation of BiH and in Republika Srpska an old-age pension is granted at 65 years of age and at least 15 years of service.
Penzije u Federaciji su ove godine povećane za 11,6 posto, a usklađuju se dvaput godišnje.
Pensions in the Federation were raised by 11.6 percent this year, and they are adjusted twice a year.

title: Aerodrom Sarajevo imao rekordnih 189.472 putnika u oktobru
Sarajevo Airport had a record 189,472 passengers in October
body: Međunarodni aerodrom Sarajevo je u oktobru opslužio 189.472 putnika.
Sarajevo International Airport served 189,472 passengers in October.
To je 4,4 posto više nego u oktobru prošle godine i najbolji oktobar u historiji aerodroma.
That is 4.4 percent more than in October last year and the best October in the airport's history.
Dvomilioniti putnik ove godine očekuje se već ove sedmice.
The two-millionth passenger of this year is expected as early as this week.
Od januara do kraja oktobra aerodrom je imao 1.973.069 putnika, što je 1 posto više nego u istom periodu prošle godine.
From January to the end of October the airport had 1,973,069 passengers, which is 1 percent more than in the same period last year.
Iz aerodroma kažu da rezultat potvrđuje pozitivne trendove u 2026. godini i bolju povezanost BiH s inostranstvom.
The airport says that the result confirms positive trends in 2026 and better connections between BiH and abroad.
Zimski red letenja počeo je 25. oktobra.
The winter flight schedule began on 25 October.
Iz Sarajeva se leti do 18 destinacija s 14 aviokompanija.
Flights from Sarajevo go to 18 destinations with 14 airlines.
Od decembra Wizz Air uvodi nove linije do Bratislave, Berlina i Praga.
From December Wizz Air introduces new routes to Bratislava, Berlin and Prague.
Zima je tradicionalno mirniji period, pa se širenje mreže linija očekuje u proljeće.
Winter is traditionally a quieter period, so an expansion of the route network is expected in spring.
Već su najavljene linije do Ženeve i Bazela, a druge destinacije bit će objavljene kasnije.
Routes to Geneva and Basel have already been announced, and other destinations will be announced later.

title: Vatrogascima u BiH predstavljena oprema za gašenje šumskih požara
Equipment for fighting forest fires presented to firefighters in BiH
body: U Ilidži je održana prezentacija moderne opreme za gašenje požara na otvorenom i vozila za tehničke intervencije.
A presentation of modern equipment for fighting fires in the open and of vehicles for technical interventions was held in Ilidža.
Događaj je organiziralo Vatrogasno društvo Ilidža, zajedno s kolegama iz Slovenije.
The event was organised by the Ilidža Fire Association together with colleagues from Slovenia.
Došli su vatrogasci iz Goražda, Bugojna, Mostara i Sarajeva.
Firefighters came from Goražde, Bugojno, Mostar and Sarajevo.
Među gostima su bili i predstavnici Sarajevo-šuma, općina i civilne zaštite.
Among the guests were also representatives of Sarajevo-šume, municipalities and civil protection.
Opremu je izradila slovenačka kompanija Pratus, koja pravi i nadogradnje za vatrogasna vozila.
The equipment was made by the Slovenian company Pratus, which also makes upgrades for fire vehicles.
Njeni predstavnici pokazali su kako se oprema koristi.
Its representatives showed how the equipment is used.
Vozila se mogu koristiti i kod drugih intervencija, na primjer kod poplava.
The vehicles can also be used in other interventions, for example during floods.
Nijaz Imamović, predsjednik Vatrogasnog društva Ilidža, rekao je da je to bila samo prezentacija.
Nijaz Imamović, president of the Ilidža Fire Association, said that it was only a presentation.
Prema njegovim riječima, danas su na terenu svi koji se bave zaštitom i spašavanjem.
In his words, everyone who deals with protection and rescue was at the site today.
Imamović očekuje da će institucije koje su vidjele opremu odlučiti hoće li je kupiti.
Imamović expects the institutions that saw the equipment to decide whether to buy it.
Nije poznato hoće li je lokalni vatrogasci dobiti.
It is not known whether local firefighters will get it.
